title_en: Anyang Automobile Transport General Company v. Nanzhuang Branch and Linqi Credit Cooperative — dispute over payment of pledged certificate of deposit
keywords_en: civil; dispute over pledge contract; second instance; High People's Court; Henan Province; legal person; Guarantee Law; General Principles of Civil Law; validity of certificate of deposit pledge agreement; protection of bona fide third party; liability for acts in the scope of employment; affirm the original judgment; certificate of deposit pledge; loan guarantee; forged certificate of deposit; good faith; guarantee; suretyship; mortgage; pledge; dispute over redemption of pledged certificate of deposit of a cooperative
full_text_en:
Anyang Automobile Transportation General Company v. Nanzhuang Branch, Linqi Credit Cooperative — Dispute over Payment of Pledged Deposit Certificate

Plaintiff: Anyang Automobile Transportation General Company, Henan Province.
Legal Representative: Meng Xuezhong, General Manager.

Defendant: Nanzhuang Branch of Linqi Credit Cooperative, Linqi Town, Linzhou City, Henan Province.
Representative: Yin Qingsheng, Director.

Defendant: Linqi Credit Cooperative, Linqi Town, Linzhou City, Henan Province.
Legal Representative: Li Fusheng, Director.

The plaintiff, Anyang Automobile Transportation General Company (hereinafter referred to as the Transportation Company), filed a lawsuit with the Anyang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province due to a dispute over the payment of a pledged deposit certificate with the defendant, Nanzhuang Branch of Linqi Credit Cooperative, Linqi Town, Linzhou City, Henan Province (hereinafter referred to as Nanzhuang Branch), and the defendant, Linqi Credit Cooperative, Linqi Town, Linzhou City, Henan Province (hereinafter referred to as the Credit Cooperative).

The plaintiff, the Transportation Company, alleged: Our company obtained a three-year fixed deposit certificate by providing a loan guarantee for another party. This deposit certificate was confirmed by the defendant Nanzhuang Branch, which issued it, and guaranteed payment upon maturity. Now that the deposit certificate has matured, we request a judgment ordering the defendants to redeem the principal and interest of this fixed deposit certificate.

The defendant Nanzhuang Branch did not submit a defense.

The defendant Credit Cooperative argued: The deposit certificate and the agreement guaranteeing redemption mentioned by the plaintiff were the result of fraudulent conduct against the plaintiff, devised by Liu Lianfu and Jia Wenqing of Nanzhuang Branch in a conspiracy to defraud the plaintiff of its guarantee. The case of Liu Lianfu and Jia Wenqing forging a deposit certificate to defraud a guarantee is already being handled by the procuratorial authorities. The plaintiff cannot rely on this forged deposit certificate to demand that our cooperative redeem the principal and interest. We request that the court reject the plaintiff's claim according to law.

The Anyang Intermediate People's Court found the following upon trial: On November 21, 1994, the Transportation Company (Party A) and the Anyang Tongya Entertainment Food Center (Party B, hereinafter referred to as the Food Center), represented by Liu Lianfu, entered into a guarantee loan agreement. The agreement stipulated: At the request of Party B, Party A shall guarantee Party B's loan of RMB 300,000 from a bank. For this purpose, Party B shall pledge to Party A a fixed deposit certificate of RMB 320,000 held by Liu Lianfu at Nanzhuang Branch. Upon maturity of the loan: 1. If Party B fails to repay the principal and interest of the bank loan, Party A shall take ownership of Party B's deposit book; 2. The loan obtained by Party B under Party A's guarantee must be deposited into Party A's bank account. This fund must be used exclusively for the internal renovation and decoration of the bus station waiting room and shall not be diverted for any other purpose. Party A has the right to supervise Party B's use of the loan. On December 25 of the same year, the Transportation Company, Liu Lianfu of the Food Center, and Nanzhuang Branch signed another agreement regarding the use of Liu Lianfu's deposit certificate as collateral. The first part of the agreement stated: My name is Liu Lianfu, and I currently have a cash deposit of RMB 320,000 at Nanzhuang Branch, with a deposit period from December 5, 1993, to December 5, 1996. To enable the Transportation Company to guarantee my loan of RMB 300,000 in Anyang City, I hereby pledge the RMB 320,000 deposit certificate to the guaranteeing party, the Transportation Company. The second part stated: My name is Jia Wenqing, and I am the director of Nanzhuang Branch. Liu Lianfu has a deposit of RMB 320,000 at our branch, which has now been pledged to the Transportation Company. Before Liu Lianfu repays the principal and interest of the loan guaranteed by the Transportation Company, this fund cannot be reported lost, withdrawn by any other means, and can only be withdrawn upon presentation of documents stamped by the General Affairs Office and Finance Office of the Transportation Company and the existing deposit certificate (Account No. 0512). Our branch provides the password for this deposit certificate. If the above procedures are not followed, the Transportation Company may pursue our branch's liability according to law. The third part stated: The Transportation Company receives Liu Lianfu's RMB 320,000 deposit certificate at Nanzhuang Branch and signs this agreement before providing Liu Lianfu with a loan guarantee of RMB 300,000. Before Liu Lianfu repays the principal and interest of the guaranteed loan, Nanzhuang Branch shall not use any means to pay out this deposit. The deposit can only be paid upon presentation of documents stamped by the General Affairs Office and Finance Office of the Transportation Company and this deposit certificate. If the above stipulations are violated, the Transportation Company may pursue all liabilities of Nanzhuang Branch according to law. After this agreement was signed, the Transportation Company obtained the deposit certificate. The deposit certificate stated: Deposit of RMB 320,000, term three years. Deposit date: December 5, 1993; maturity date: December 5, 1996. Interest calculated at a monthly rate of 10.2‰. The deposit certificate bore the seals of Nanzhuang Branch and the handling officer. From January 16, 1995, to November 13 of the same year, the Transportation Company provided guarantees in four installments for loans totaling RMB 390,000 obtained by the Food Center from four financial institutions, including the Business Department of the Agricultural Bank of China, Anyang Branch. Because the Food Center failed to repay the loans within the prescribed period, on April 25, 1996, and July 25 of the same year, the Transportation Company was debited a total of RMB 116,991.64 to repay the debts on three occasions. Upon maturity of the fixed deposit certificate, Nanzhuang Branch refused to redeem it, leading to a dispute and the Transportation Company filing a lawsuit with the court.

Further findings: Nanzhuang Branch was originally the Nanzhuang Branch of Xizhang Credit Cooperative, Linqi Town, Linzhou City, and changed to its current name on May 13, 1995. Regarding this forged deposit certificate issued under the original name of Nanzhuang Branch, the Linzhou City People's Procuratorate is conducting a trial against Liu Lianfu and Jia Wenqing on suspicion of forging marketable securities.

The Anyang Intermediate People's Court held: The case of Liu Lianfu and Jia Wenqing, a staff member of the defendant Nanzhuang Branch, forging marketable securities has been handled in a separate proceeding. The issue to be resolved in this case is whether the agreement among the plaintiff Transportation Company, Nanzhuang Branch, and Liu Lianfu of the Food Center to pledge the deposit certificate as collateral is valid. The Guarantee Law of the People's Republic of China came into effect on October 1, 1995. This agreement was signed on December 25, 1994, and the Guarantee Law may be applied by reference. By reference to Article 75 of the Guarantee Law, this agreement is a pledge of rights agreement. The deposit certificate used as the pledged object and the pledge agreement both bore the genuine official seal of Nanzhuang Branch. Therefore, this should be regarded as the act of Nanzhuang Branch, not the personal act of its staff member. The pledge agreement stipulated that the deposit certificate could only be withdrawn upon presentation of documents stamped by the General Affairs Office and Finance Office of the Transportation Company and the existing deposit certificate. Thus, the parties to this case are the Transportation Company, which holds the rights, and Nanzhuang Branch, which bears the payment obligation. The formal requirements of the pledged deposit certificate are genuine, and it has legal binding force externally. Moreover, in the pledge agreement, Nanzhuang Branch not only confirmed the authenticity of the deposit certificate but also promised the method of withdrawal, indicating its willingness to bear legal liability. By reference to Articles 76 and 77 of the Guarantee Law, this agreement took effect upon delivery of the deposit certificate to the Transportation Company, and Nanzhuang Branch is obligated to redeem the deposit certificate upon maturity. Accordingly, on June 14, 1997, the court rendered the following judgment: Nanzhuang Branch shall redeem the principal of RMB 320,000 and interest of RMB 117,504 of the deposit certificate to the Transportation Company; the defendant Credit Cooperative shall bear joint and several liability for Nanzhuang Branch's redemption of the said deposit and interest.

After the first-instance judgment was announced, the defendant Credit Cooperative, dissatisfied, appealed to the Henan High People's Court based on the reasons stated in its first-instance defense, requesting the reversal of the original judgment and a judgment dismissing the Transportation Company's claim.

The Henan High People's Court found upon second-instance trial that the facts were substantially the same as those found in the first instance. Additional findings: In 1994, Liu Lianfu leased the old bus station of the appellee Transportation Company to operate the Food Center. To renovate the station, a loan was needed, and the Transportation Company agreed to guarantee this loan. The Food Center has now ceased operations for over a year. The 39 loans totaling RMB 390,000 that the Transportation Company guaranteed for the Food Center have all passed their repayment dates. Because the Food Center failed to repay the loans, the Transportation Company has paid off part of the loans at the request of the creditors.

The Henan High People's Court held: The deposit certificate involved in this case is genuine in form and bears authentic official seals, thus possessing legal binding force externally. Since the formal requirements of the deposit certificate are complete, the appellee Transportation Company had sufficient reason to believe in its authenticity. Therefore, the Transportation Company exercised reasonable care and acted in good faith. Jia Wenqing was a staff member of the original defendant Nanzhuang Branch. Pursuant to Article 43 of the General Principles of Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, Nanzhuang Branch shall bear the civil liability arising from the official acts of its staff member. The deposit certificate held by the Transportation Company has matured, and Nanzhuang Branch shall redeem its principal and interest. Nanzhuang Branch is a branch of the appellee Credit Cooperative. Therefore, the Credit Cooperative is legally required to participate in the proceedings as a party in this case and, where Nanzhuang Branch is unable to assume liability for repayment, to directly assume the debt repayment liability. The Credit Cooperative's ground of appeal that Liu Lianfu and Jia Wenqing's forgery of the deposit certificate has been handled by the judicial authorities and that our cooperative should not bear civil liability for this forged deposit certificate cannot be sustained. The main facts found in the first instance are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the judgment is appropriate, and it should be upheld. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Henan High People's Court rendered the following judgment on September 22, 1997:

Appeal rejected, original judgment affirmed.
